fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' throws a boomerang in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second and extending its range each time it hits a target. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays over 1 second.
fields.description2: Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not hit a target in the last 500 units of travelling, it homes back to '''Akshan''' and applies the same effects to enemies hit.
fields.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
fields.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single hit. They do not prevent the initial throw from extending its range.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
